name: player_find_third_probe_and_compute_normal
description: Player::FindThirdProbeAndComputeNormal selects a compatible third probe sample and rebuilds the terrain normal, player height, and orientation.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player post-move environment cluster pass so modal probe transform temporaries, mask selection, x87 comparisons, and orientation rebuild call context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42d320 validates scanning up to min(g_PlayerEnvProbeSampleCount, 4), skipping the first two above-ground indices, transforming modal probe points at base offset 15 through motionBasis, selecting the best positive candidateScoreBySample-minus-transformedY delta with zero CheckProbeSampleMaskOverlap, requiring delta > g_Player_DeltaTime, then rebuilding a support triangle, solving world Y, and calling RebuildOrientationFromNormal.
The native smoke verifies compatible third-probe selection, terrain normal rebuild, solved height, and orientation rebuild side effects.
